notes: Round 6 (puppets_r6, 2.2M decisions; sandbox_r1, 420k decisions on the ragdolls). Puppets: the deer learned the wolves. Four in five deaths were kills at the start of the round and none at its end; 98% die of old age after 790 s. Ragdolls: the deer graze with their own necks (feeding 18% of the time, the grass goes down), a life in the world went from 100 s to 320 s, all still starve there. On both, no conception: near and pair pay 0.001 a decision, the deer are seldom within 10 m of a mate and never both in Mate mode long enough. Round 7: the rules ask less of a pair (2 s together within two lengths, not 3 s within one and a half), the time a pair has spent together is paid as it builds (the new mating signal), pairing in reach pays more, courting by the metre is paid whatever the store.

terms.name: graze
terms.expr: 0.004 * step(0.8 - energy) * mode_feed * step(grass_here - 0.1) * max(0, 1 - muzzle_height)

terms.name: pair
terms.expr: 0.2 * adult * (1 - pregnant) * step(energy - 0.5) * mode_mate * step(4 - mate_distance)
